profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer | Full Stack | React · Node · AWS · Kubernetes
profile.summary:
Staff Software Engineer with 8 years of experience building and scaling full-stack systems across healthcare, EV infrastructure, and utilities. I specialize in JavaScript/TypeScript across the entire stack — React, Node, NestJS, GraphQL — with deep experience in AWS, Kubernetes, and distributed systems.
 
I bring strong technical depth across the full lifecycle — from architecting real-time search systems and database migrations to owning observability strategy and shipping production features at scale. I've also stepped into leadership when needed, mentoring engineers to promotion and translating architectural tradeoffs for directors and C-suite — but at heart I'm an engineer who loves solving hard technical problems.

Recent wins include cutting query latency by 66%, driving a database migration from problem identification through roadmap approval to delegated execution, and architecting a real-time search system that took a product from unshippable to live.

Current experience with: Javascript, Typescript, ReactJS, HTML/CSS, GraphQL, Node/Express, NestJS, WebSockets, PostgreSQL, MongoDB (DocumentDB), OpenSearch, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, Grafana/Prometheus, Amazon Web Services (AWS), SQS, ArcGIS, Jest
Previous experience with: Angular, Python, Java, Nginx, jQuery
